name: d_delegation_drain
title: (d) Hot wallet delegation drain (EIP-7702)
description: A compromised withdrawal service asks the hot wallet to sign a type-4 transaction with 5 authorizations (nonces 3-7) that delegate it to MockSweeper. The wallet's nonce is 6: the tx itself uses 6, so the authorization with nonce 7 matches. The request contains no sweep call; the Guard's probe finds it. The hot wallet is Anvil test account #1, so the sandbox replays a real type-4 tx.

requests.label: type-4 tx with 5 authorizations to MockSweeper
requests.plain: Hot wallet asked to hand control to an unknown contract
